text:
tablet_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1 or bed_b1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active electronics during the day.
glass_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually kitchen_table_k1 or cupboard_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware, cupboard_k1 for storage.
charger_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually entry_hook_e1. Check entry_hook_e1 for charging accessories when leaving/arriving.
mug_felix: Assumed cupboard_k1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.
razor_felix: Assumed medicine_cabinet_ba1; actually bathroom_shelf_ba1. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first for grooming items.
water_bottle_felix: Assumed dish_rack_k1; actually kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for active drinkware.
book_felix: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually bed_b1. Check bed_b1 for reading materials.
